image_description: A close-up, black-and-white photograph of a bicycle's front wheel assembly, focusing on the disc brake system. The image shows a perforated disc brake rotor, a caliper mounted over the rotor, a fork leg, and part of the tire. There is some text visible on the fork and a watermark in the bottom right corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A caliper assembly is visible mounted over the edge of the rotor, attached to the fork.
